description: This file defines the AgentService class, which handles the core logic for a reactive AI agent that interacts with multiple tools and a chat service, manages conversation flow, executes actions, and processes responses within a Flutter application.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for agent errors, including specific error types and details.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class managing the agent's state, conversation flow, tools, and execution of actions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent's internal state, including steps, messages, and running flag, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Main method to initiate a conversation with provided user input, handles message exchange, action execution, and error handling.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the conversation with timestamp, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes the set of available tools with file I/O, time, and calculation functionalities.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes an action command using the corresponding tool, handling errors if the tool is not found.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of arguments, handling quotes and trimming spaces.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content enclosed within specified XML tags from text.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Generates the initial system prompt instructing the agent on how to perform reasoning and actions with strict formatting rules.
